_comment: The testnet deployment as one desired state (#3111, deploy rehearsal design sections 3 and 16). script/deploy-plan.mjs reads it and prints the plan a rehearsal runs and the real deploy follows; the readback (#3893) checks the live chains against it. Lanes and reward sources are DERIVED from the chain set, never typed. Role holders are named by the operator .env variable that carries the address (public values), so this file holds no address that could drift from the .env.

rewards._why: Owner decision 2026-11-16: 100,000 VPFI to the Base reward pool, sourced from the treasury wallet through the admin. The anchor is set per run (deploy-plan --anchor today) unless fixed here.

governance._why: Owner decision for the 2026-11-16 fresh deploy, kept: testnet roles stay admin-owned (no Safe handover on testnets).

terms._why: Terms v4 (PR #3784) is set on-chain with the next deploy; the hash is read from apps/www/src/pages/terms/versions.ts.

_settingsSource: Owner decision 2026-11-22 (Raaj, via the coordinator): the next testnet deploys must exercise every feature, so every switch is on, with the figures the 2026-11-04 deploy used (read from its archived Diamonds). A mainnet desired file may hold no row carried from a replaced deployment.

On-chain evidence read 2026-11-22: PancakeSwap's v3 factory answers at its canonical address on all three testnets (feeAmountTickSpacing(500) = 10, the same poolDeployer 0x41ff9AA7e16B8B1a8a8dc4f0eFacd93D02d071c9 on each). Its published page lists no testnet; design ruling 2026-11-22: where the venue exists, set the address.

On-chain evidence read 2026-11-22: 1inch Router v6 (which carries Limit Order Protocol v4) answers on Base Sepolia: eip712Domain() names "1inch Aggregation Router" version 6. Its published list names mainnets only; design ruling 2026-11-22: where the venue exists, set the address.
owner decision 2026-11-22 (Raaj): the next testnet deploys switch every feature on; the figures are the 2026-11-04 deploy's; the instant market is a feature, so it is on

design ruling 2026-11-22, instant borrow source cap (designs/notes/2026-11-22-instant-borrow-source-cap.md): 2 on every network until the gas suite shows room; Ethereum's per-transaction cap is the tightest

sanctionsClearance._why: Owner decision 2026-11-16: rewire the sanctions delisting route after all three chains are deployed; BNB testnet answers clearance requests for the Base and Arbitrum timelocks (ConfigureSanctionsClearance header).

getBaseRewardDeployment().reason: Base is the canonical reward chain; only a mirror records the Base reward deployment it reports to.

getRewardRemittanceReceiver().reason: The reward remittance receiver takes Base's budget on a mirror; Base sends remittances and receives none.

getRewardRemittanceKeeper().reason: Remitting the reward budget is a Base-only action, so the remittance keeper is set on Base alone; a mirror keeps the zero default, under which only the admin could remit and the mirror never does.

getBuybackRemittanceReceiver().reason: Buyback remittances are received on the canonical chain only; a mirror sends its buyback share to Base.

getVPFIMinter().reason: VPFI is minted on the canonical chain only; a mirror holds the CCIP mirror token, which has no minter on the Diamond.

getRateModel().reason: Rate-reference thread 2026-11-22: nothing reads the rate model; the identity model applies, and the model is slated for removal in the refactor.

getFusionLimitOrderProtocol().reason: 1inch's Limit Order Protocol v4 (Router v6) is not on Arbitrum Sepolia or BNB testnet: absent from its published list, and its address holds no code there. Swap-to-repay by limit order is unavailable on these chains.

getSushiswapV3Factory().reason: SushiSwap v3 has no factory on Base Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia or BNB testnet: Sushi's own SUSHISWAP_V3_FACTORY_ADDRESS map (evm/config/features/sushiswap-v3.ts in the sushi package 7.7.0) lists Sepolia, Tatara and Bokuto as its only testnets, and the mainnet factory addresses hold no code on these chains. The Sushi venue is unavailable on these testnets.

notRecorded.DiamondInterfacesInit: A one-shot initializer DeployDiamond creates and runs once inside the diamond cut that writes the ERC-165 table; nothing calls it afterwards, so the deploy keeps its address in a local variable and writes no record of it.

_notDeployedHereWhy: #3893, design ruling 2026-11-22: the readback refuses a zero answer from a Diamond getter that names a deployment contract, and refuses a revert outright, unless the getter is listed here. byDesign: a zero the canonical/mirror split explains (design checks each). venue: an outside contract absent from the chain, with the venue's published deployment list and the date read; where the venue exists, its address is set instead. On mainnet every entry needs the owner's recorded acceptance. awaitingRuling rows are shown, neither met nor failed, and are refused on mainnet.
